verdict.rationale: QuickBooks ships several built-in automations (auto-categorization rules, automated payment reminders, auto-generated reconciliation reports, Payroll AI that 'proactively' collects data) and an official MCP server exposing 145 tools/CRUD operations that an AI agent could call, but these are either fixed platform rules or on-demand chat/tool invocations rather than a user-configurable framework for autonomous, scheduled background agent workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined triggers/schedules for AI agents, a documented autonomous/background execution mode (vs. request-response tool calls), and independent confirmation that MCP-driven automations run unattended.
